fields.description: The clocking terminal / device identifier as it appears in legacy .DAT export rows and in Employee Checkin.device_id (HIKVision). Rows are added here automatically when a Clocking * Import job encounters a device not yet listed - see is_attendance.controllers.clocking_import.sync_clocking_machines.
fields.label: Clocking Machine ID

fields.description: Left blank on an auto-added row - set this so the device stops falling through to Employee/Fallback Branch resolution. Not required: a blank Branch here simply means this device contributes nothing to Branch resolution, same as if it weren't listed at all.
fields.label: Branch
